arxiv-2104-08140.title: Structural phase stability, electronic structure, magnetic properties and chemical bonding analysis of transition metal ammine borohydrides with amphoteric hydrogen for hydrogen storage
arxiv-2104-08140.description: Abstract Usually the ions of a particular element in solids are in positive or negative oxidation states, depending upon the chemical environment. It is highly unusual for an atom having both positive as well as negative oxidation states simultaneously within the same structural framework in a particular compound.

arxiv-2108-10897.title: Higher-order topological superconductivity from repulsive interactions in kagome and honeycomb systems
arxiv-2108-10897.creator: Tommy Li, Max Geier, Julian Ingham, Harley D. Scammell
arxiv-2108-10897.description: Abstract We discuss a pairing mechanism in interacting two-dimensional multipartite lattices that intrinsically leads to a second order topological superconducting state with a spatially modulated gap. When the chemical potential is close to Dirac points, oppositely moving electrons on the Fermi surface undergo an interference phenomenon in which the Berry phase converts a repulsive electron-electron interaction into an effective attraction.

arxiv-2207-04100.title: Dealing with multi-currency inventory risk in FX cash markets
arxiv-2207-04100.creator: Alexander Barzykin, Philippe Bergault, Olivier Guéant
arxiv-2207-04100.description: Abstract In FX cash markets, market makers provide liquidity to clients for a wide variety of currency pairs. Because of flow uncertainty and market volatility, they face inventory risk. To mitigate this risk, they typically skew their prices to attract or divert the flow and trade with their peers on the dealer-to-dealer segment of the market for hedging purposes.

arxiv-2309-14788.title: Small-Space Algorithms for the Online Language Distance Problem for Palindromes and Squares
arxiv-2309-14788.creator: Gabriel Bathie, Tomasz Kociumaka, Tatiana Starikovskaya
arxiv-2309-14788.description: Abstract We study the online variant of the language distance problem for two classical formal languages, the language of palindromes and the language of squares, and for the two most fundamental distances, the Hamming distance and the edit (Levenshtein) distance.

arxiv-2310-06077.title: Performative Time-Series Forecasting
arxiv-2310-06077.creator: Zhiyuan Zhao, Alexander Rodriguez, B. Aditya Prakash
arxiv-2310-06077.description: Abstract Time-series forecasting is a critical challenge in various domains and has witnessed substantial progress in recent years. Many real-life scenarios, such as public health, economics, and social applications, involve feedback loops where predictions can influence the predicted outcome, subsequently altering the target variable’s distribution. This phenomenon, known as performativity , introduces the potential for ’self-negating’ or ’self-fulfilling’ predictions.

arxiv-2404-08857.title: Voice Attribute Editing with Text Prompt Corresponding author
arxiv-2404-08857.creator: Zhengyan Sheng, Yang Ai, Li-Juan Liu, Jia Pan, Zhen-Hua Ling
arxiv-2404-08857.description: Abstract Despite recent advancements in speech generation with text prompt providing control over speech style, voice attributes in synthesized speech remain elusive and challenging to control. This paper introduces a novel task: voice attribute editing with text prompt, with the goal of making relative modifications to voice attributes according to the actions described in the text prompt.

arxiv-2405-12657.title: On Edwards’ Speculation and a New Variational Method for the Zeros of the Z Z -Function
arxiv-2405-12657.creator: Yochay Jerby
arxiv-2405-12657.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yochay Jerby. In his foundational book, Edwards introduced a unique ”speculation” regarding the possible theoretical origins of the Riemann Hypothesis, based on the properties of the Riemann-Siegel formula. arxiv-2407-03309.title: Unimodality and peak location of the characteristic polynomials of two distance matrices of trees
arxiv-2407-03309.creator: Rakesh Jana, Iswar Mahato, Sivaramakrishnan Sivasubramanian
arxiv-2407-03309.description: Abstract Unimodality of the normalized coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of distance matrices of trees are known and bounds on the location of its peak (the largest coefficient) are also known. Recently, an extension of these results to distance matrices of block graphs was given.

arxiv-2407-15863.title: Overfitting In Contrastive Learning?
arxiv-2407-15863.creator: Zachary Rabin, Jim Davis, Benjamin Lewis, Matthew Scherreik
arxiv-2407-15863.description: Abstract Overfitting describes a machine learning phenomenon where the model fits too closely to the training data, resulting in poor generalization. While this occurrence is thoroughly documented for many forms of supervised learning, it is not well examined in the context of un supervised learning. In this work we examine the nature of overfitting in unsupervised contrastive learning.

arxiv-2601-19485.title: On the gauge invariance of the Kuperberg invariant of certain high genus framed 3-manifolds
arxiv-2601-19485.creator: Liang Chang, Yilong Wang, Saifei Zhai
arxiv-2601-19485.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Liang Chang, Yilong Wang, Saifei Zhai. We show that the Kuperberg invariant of the Weeks manifold with any framing is a gauge invariant of finite-dimensional Hopf algebras, which provides the first example of gauge invariants of general finite-dimensional Hopf algebras via hyperbolic 3-manifolds. We also show that the Kuperberg invariant of the 3-torus is gauge invariant, which further supports the idea of systematically producing gauge invariants of Hopf algebras via topological methods proposed in [ 2 ] .

pmc-10649038.title: Changes in the Epidemiology of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Carinthia, Austria, 2012–2023
pmc-10649038.creator: Florian Hucke, Heleen Emmer, Roberto Emmer, Miriam Hucke, Simona Bota, Matthias Fürstner, Klaus Hausegger, Reinhard Mittermair, Markus Peck-Radosavljevic
pmc-10649038.description: Simple SummaryHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a type of primary liver malignancy. Worldwide, HCC is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths in adults. Liver cancer is currently the sixth most common cancer worldwide. Many changes in the epidemiology and underlying etiology of HCC have taken place in recent years.

pmc-11225433.title: Domestic violence against Iranian pregnant adolescents: protective and risk factors
pmc-11225433.creator: Mona Rahnavardi, Zahra Bostani Khalesi, Zahra hazrati
pmc-11225433.description: BackgroundDomestic violence is an important health, which has serious impacts on women's health. The study aimed to discover the protective and risk factors of domestic violence among pregnant adolescents.Materials and MethodsIn the analytical cross-sectional study, 255 eligible pregnant women aged 14–20 years who have been referred to Al-Zahra Hospital, in northern Iran between September 2020 and March 2022 participated.

pmc-11318092.title: Neural regulation of mesenchymal stem cells in craniofacial bone: development, homeostasis and repair
pmc-11318092.creator: Huai-Jin Pi, Bo Huang, Quan Yuan, Jun-Jun Jing
pmc-11318092.description: Mesenchymal stem cells endow various functions, including proliferation, multipotency, migration, etc. Craniofacial bones originate from the cranial neural crest and are developed mainly through intramembranous ossification, which are different from long bones. There are varied mesenchymal stem cells existing in the craniofacial bone, including Gli1 + cells, Axin2 + cells, Prx1 + cells, etc.

pmc-11427323.title: Neu1 deficiency and fibrotic lymph node microenvironment lead to imbalance in M1/M2 macrophage polarization
pmc-11427323.creator: Emilia Escalona, Alexandra Olate-Briones, Sofía Albornoz-Muñoz, Enzo Bonacic-Doric, Francisca Rodríguez-Arriaza, Andrés A. Herrada, Noelia Escobedo
pmc-11427323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Macrophages play a pivotal role in tissue homeostasis, pathogen defense, and inflammation resolution. M1 and M2 macrophage phenotypes represent two faces in a spectrum of responses to microenvironmental changes, crucial in both physiological and pathological conditions. Neuraminidase 1 (Neu1), a lysosomal and cell surface sialidase responsible for removing terminal sialic acid residues from glycoconjugates, modulates several macrophage functions, including phagocytosis and Toll-like receptor (TLR) signaling.

pmc-11506790.title: DNA Methylation as a Molecular Mechanism of Carcinogenesis in World Trade Center Dust Exposure: Insights from a Structured Literature Review
pmc-11506790.creator: Stephanie Tuminello, Nedim Durmus, Matija Snuderl, Yu Chen, Yongzhao Shao, Joan Reibman, Alan A. Arslan, Emanuela Taioli
pmc-11506790.description: The collapse of the World Trade Center (WTC) buildings in New York City generated a large plume of dust and smoke. WTC dust contained human carcinogens including metals, asbestos, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), persistent organic pollutants (POPs, including polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) and dioxins), and benzene.

pmc-11546400.title: Effectiveness and Safety of GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Patients with Type 1 Diabetes
pmc-11546400.creator: Sumaya N Almohareb, Osamah M Alfayez, Shoroq S Aljuaid, Walaa A Alshahrani, Ghalia Bakhsh, Mohammed K Alshammari, Majed S Al Yami, Omar A Alshaya, Abdullah S Alomran, Ghazwa B Korayem, Omar A Almohammed, Alberto Martínez-Castelao, Carmen Quirós
pmc-11546400.description: Background: GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) are used in the management of type II diabetes mellitus or obesity, although its role in patients with type I diabetes mellitus (T1DM) has been debated. This study aimed to investigate the efficacy and safety of GLP-1RA in patients with T1DM using real-world data.

pmc-12636016.title: Enantioselective Synthesis of (+)-Auriculatol A
pmc-12636016.creator: Jordan K. Thompson, Kala C. Youngblood, Yun Hao Shawn Teh, Conner M. Farley, Zhehao Zhang, Scott C. Virgil, Sarah E. Reisman
pmc-12636016.description: A total synthesis of the grayanane diterpenoid (+)-auriculatol A is reported. The synthesis features a convergent coupling strategy that joins two fragments by a vinylogous Mukaiyama–aldol-type reaction and then constructs the 7-membered ring by a Ni-catalyzed enolate alkenylation. Key findings include the development of a chemoselective Ni-catalyzed intramolecular 1,2-addition to access the bicyclo[3.2.

pmc-12645199.title: Gas-containing cystic intradural lumbar disc herniation at L1–2, a rare diagnosis confirmed by discography and review of the literature: illustrative case
pmc-12645199.creator: Kosuke Sugiura, Makoto Takeuchi, Masatoshi Morimoto, Hiroaki Manabe, Fumitake Tezuka, Kazuta Yamashita, Junzo Fujitani, Koichi Sairyo
pmc-12645199.description: BACKGROUNDIntradural disc herniation (IDH) is an uncommon clinical entity, composing only 0.26%–0.30% of lumbar disc herniations. Most IDHs occur at L4–5 or L5–S1, and cases at L1–2 are extremely rare. Preoperative diagnosis is often difficult because IDH can mimic an intradural tumor, hematoma, or cyst on MRI.

pmc-12729864.title: Competency-based spiritual care education program for undergraduate nursing students: a quasi-experimental study
pmc-12729864.creator: Sara Sitefane, Ana Afonso, Linda Ross, Wilfred Mcsherry, Isabel Rabiais, Sílvia Caldeira
pmc-12729864.description: BackgroundThe International Council of Nurses underscores the importance of integrating spirituality into holistic nursing care, advocating for the recognition and respect of individuals’ spiritual beliefs and values. Addressing this need, the European project EPICC (Enhancing Nurses’ and Midwives’ Competence in Providing Spiritual Care through Innovative Education and Compassionate Care) promotes the development of spiritual care competencies within nursing curricula.

pmc-13098208.title: The respiratory microbiome in pulmonary tuberculosis: a meta-analysis reveals niche-specific microbial and functional signatures
pmc-13098208.creator: Mingyang Qin, Yanhua Wen, Shanshan Li, Song Li, Xuming Li, Yuting Lin, Long Hu, Han Xia, Yu Pang, Liang Li
pmc-13098208.description: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major global health challenge. The close relationship between the microbiome and the host is becoming increasingly notable. While studies on the respiratory microbiome in pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) exist, a comprehensive understanding of microbial characteristics across the entire respiratory tract is still lacking.

pmc-13113714.title: First Report of a Hollow Cranial Crest in an Early-Diverging Duck-Billed Dinosaur, with Implications for Convergent Evolution of Acoustic Signaling
pmc-13113714.creator: Qingyu Ma, Yubo Ma, Chao Tan, Jian Chen, Yu Lin, Ming Xiao, Hui Dai, Guangbiao Wei, Jordan C. Mallon, Jun Wang, Han Yao, Zhengting Zou, Hai Xing
pmc-13113714.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryConvergent evolution is a peculiar biological process in which distinct taxa or lineages independently evolve analogous features, structures and functions, to adapt to similar necessities. Here we present a classic instance of morphological and functional convergence of the hollow cranial crest among hadrosauroid dinosaurs, based on an excellently preserved skull of the early-branching hadrosauroid Qianjiangsaurus changshengi newly recovered from southwest China, as well as comparative resonant frequency evaluations of its unique endonasal (‘within the nasal bone’) cavities using CT scans and

pmc-13180079.title: Magnesium depletion score and circadian syndrome: Mediated by body mass index
pmc-13180079.creator: Ying Wang, Jiaqi Wu, Yunan Zhang, Peiyang Yu, Gongwei Wen, Kuncai Li, Xuan Zhang, Ronghui Xiang, Ziyang Zheng
pmc-13180079.description: ObjectiveCircadian syndrome (CircS) is a recently defined condition encompassing metabolic, sleep, and mental health disturbances. Magnesium plays a vital role in metabolic and neurological processes, and magnesium depletion score (MDS) has emerged as a practical biomarker for magnesium deficiency. This cross-sectional retrospective study aimed to investigate the association between MDS and CircS in a nationally representative U.S. population.

pmc-13560257.title: Perinatal exposure to nano-polystyrene: deleterious imprinting on inflammatory bowel diseases
pmc-13560257.creator: Melvin Airaud, Amandine Roldan, Jeanne Le Cléac’h, Lisa Isoard, Marie Carrière, Sandrine Ménard, Frédérick Barreau
pmc-13560257.description: BackgroundThe extent of production and use of plastics leads to release of nanoplastics (NPL) into the environment, where they undergo weathering that could alter their toxicological properties. NPL enter the human food chain via contaminated food, and food packaging, and within the body they are known to pass through epithelial barriers.

uslaw-usc-t23-s167.title: 23 U.S.C. § 167 — National highway freight program
uslaw-usc-t23-s167.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t23-s167.description: United States Code, Title 23 (Highways); Chapter 1 (Federal-Aid Highways). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— (1) Policy.— It is the policy of the United States to improve the condition and performance of the National Highway Freight Network established under this section to ensure that the Network provides the foundation for the United States to compete in the global economy.
